details: 1.0.74 Windows read the full image (28246 wire bytes) then the stock icx90 get_memory indexed a table with an out-of-range bitfield (mode 2 bits/3 values, tone mode 3/4, step 4/13, tones 6/50, DTCS 8/104). No image attached. Lookups are now bounded and logged so one channel cannot stop the list; the image is needed to identify the field.
summary: Read succeeds but channel map decode fails: list index out of range
